Shortening the slot frees roughly 400 staff hours a quarter.

state.proposal_text: Recommendation: fund two dedicated onboarding specialists for the Fieldstone enterprise tier, at an estimated annual cost of $240,000, starting in Q1. The case for this is Brindlecote Logistics. Their operations lead, Marisol Venn, told me on our last call that they came close to cancelling because nobody owned their rollout after the sales handoff, and that the only reason they stayed was that an engineer volunteered evenings to walk them through configuration. Anyone who has sat in on an enterprise kickoff knows this is how it goes. Two specialists would take that load off engineering and give each new account a named owner.

If the direction of a described consequence is unclear or contradictory, select unknown. Do not judge whether a named downside is likely, complete, or adequately mitigated. state.proposal_text: Proposal: launch the Meridian mid-market bundle in the spring cycle with a dedicated sales pod. Risks: as with any launch there is execution risk, and there are the usual uncertainties around timing and adoption, all of which we consider manageable. The real risk is in not launching. If we hold the bundle back another cycle, Corvane Industrial will lock up the mid-market accounts we are targeting, our renewal conversations in that segment will get harder, and the sales pod we have already hired will sit idle. The upside is a new revenue line and a foothold in a segment where we currently have none.
